description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dhutugemunu, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520802
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, owners, property extents, encumbrances, and legal rights associated with the properties. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
